title: Florida Foundation Seed Producers variety page - Emerald
summary: Licensing page for Emerald noting target spot susceptibility and a first harvest around 22 April at Gainesville, and listing licensed nurseries.
why_it_matters: The licensing body's pages establish who may legally propagate each UF cultivar and in which territories, which is the practical constraint on how far public genetics can spread. Where its published trait figures diverge from the breeding programme's own, the divergence itself is a finding.

testing.rationale: Chill-hour figures are testable in a target production region.

commercial_position.rationale: Licence availability determines whether a competitor can access these genetics at all.

monitoring.rationale: Licensed-nursery lists change as agreements are signed.
